description: Audited lifetime contracts for cuOpt. Argument indexes are zero-based explicit arguments; receivers are separate. Names identify semantic qualified declarations after template-argument and inline-namespace normalization. Unsupported entries are coverage diagnostics, never proof of safety.

storage.referent: Storage of the referred object itself, not pointee data.
storage.pointee: Storage reached through a pointer argument.
storage.container_data: Backing allocation of an owning container or view; moving the handle does not kill storage.

schema.when: arg_types maps argument index strings to pointer, arithmetic_or_enum, or record:<normalized qualified name>. Unsupported selectors must emit a coverage diagnostic.
schema.stream: Exactly one of arg, receiver, handle_arg, receiver_member, event_arg, or all. Event and handle streams require state resolution; absence of resolution is not completion.
schema.success_return: Synchronize effect applies only on a path where the CUDA call returned cudaSuccess; failures and not-ready queries do not retire borrows.
schema.device_only: Borrow is an allocation/stream-ordering contract, not a host stack-object lifetime contract.
schema.retained_by: Receiver, argument, returned owner, or output descriptor retains pointee storage; ordinary synchronization does not release the retained borrow.
schema.min_args: Count explicit AST call arguments, including synthesized default arguments; constructor selectors distinguish scalar/data/deep-copy overloads.
schema.ownership: Owned result may move. Device deallocation can safely follow same-stream uses without a host sync, but other-stream uses require dependencies.
